instruction: Set up a 30-minute call with Kenji at 9am Thursday his time. He's in Tokyo.
final_text:
I scheduled a 30-minute call with Kenji Watanabe (kenji@tsubame.example) and sent him an invitation.

- **His time:** Thursday, Oct 1, 9:00–9:30 AM JST
- **Your time:** Wednesday, Sept 30, 5:00–5:30 PM PDT

Your calendar is clear at that time. I didn't add a video link or location, so you'll need to send one if you want it on the invite.

content.text: Thursday 9:00 JST is Wednesday 17:00 PDT, and Sam is free then.
